WS-1 (SI, since-inception): push the Model Portfolios Global-view time series back to the earliest FULL model-portfolio daily data. DECISION pending (Andrew/Yang): TTW = 10 trading days (rec) vs 14 calendar -- one shared definition across all surfaces.
